nom: CeraVe Hydrating Mineral Sunscreen Face Lotion with Sheer Tint SPF 30

avis.texte: It's shocking to me that people like this. It goes on very dense, and it it NOT sheer. The color is weird and it leaves a cast.

I just started using the tinted spf 30 moisturizer. I was pleasantly surprised how much I like this product. It blended well, didnt settle in lines and has good sun protection. I use it as my go-to light foundation everday. Highly recommend.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It was a really great product over all the application was smooth it went on smoooth and stayed for the whole day, definitely on the lighter side of makeup

I got this before vacation and noticed that my skin was really sensitive on the trip, but chalked it up to makeup wipes and rollercoasters. By the end of the week, my eyelids were scaly and flaky, and the skin near my mouth was peeling. Tried to repair my barrier and no matter what I did, even LRP cicabalm, my face still stung. For months, I changed my skincare routine, one product at a time. I was at the end of options and saw my sunscreen in the cabinet, which was the last straw. The tube doesnt have the ingredients, so I had to go through my ulta account to find them. No idea why cerave added salicylic acid to the formula, but it's there - and I think its in there twice. So, sensitive faces, beware. Disappointed for sure, and out tons of money trying to fix the barrier I was slowly damaging over and over again.
This sweat off easily. Then when i wiped my face it just came off. It also got on my clothes
This turned me orange bu the end of the day. I'll probably nust use it for beach days

avis.titre: I use this instead of foundation, many days
avis.texte: Glowy, minimal coverage with SPF I need every day. I love this product! It blends in completely, and works well with the makeup I used on top of it.
This product is my holy grail. I have oily, acne prone, and large pores and this is absolutely stunning on me. I wish it lasted longer but I just reapply every 2 hours and it looks flawless.

avis.titre: Keeps me from burning and no need for foundation
avis.texte: It's great. Sales associate thought I should buy it in medium so I could " get a little color" but the medium was too dark and would have looked fake. LOVE it in light- not too dark for pale skin

I got the medium for this and I have light to medium skin. Pros include that in my opinion it's the right level of coverage for a sunscreen- I could apply it with my hands and it was noticeable but it wasn't a crazy amount of coverage, or one of those tinted moisturizers that I feel like I have to use a brush for. I didn't think it looked greasy and have thought other sunscreen products from this brand have looked greasy before. The color itself looks fine on my skin- but this is SO messy and seems to get on everything. I have found it's better if I put my shirt on first, apply this and then apply translucent powder on top of it. But sometimes I just want to throw this on my face and call it a day! I also don't think it smells good. But because it doesn't break me out (which is a common issue with anything SPF for me) and the price point, I will happily use it and would consider repurchasing. I also think it washes off easily which I guess is a perk to it not being transfer-proof, lol.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this sunscreen so much. I love the texture and it melts great into my skin! You have to really rub it into your skin so it doesn't leave a cast.
My husband told me my face was orange after using this sunscreen, which is was!

avis.titre: Staying safe and looking good doing it
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the tint, for a sheer color, it does offer a bit of coverage. The spf is higher than a lot of the other facial or cosmetic sunscreens I usually use which is nice. It also doesn't leave me looking like a shiny mess, it has a really nice matte finish.

avis.titre: I have bought this over and over again!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product! I have been using it for years and years and it's something I will always repurchase. It goes well under makeup or just by itself, which is how I use it most of the time. This is a great product! Highly recommend! Grab it!
I use to buy this all the time but it seems.like they changed the formula making it more oily and slightly a different shade so it doesn't really fit my skin color anymore
I like this product i got one june 2025 and then one march 2026 the first one still has some

avis.titre: A slight glow, evened skin tone, and sun protection!
avis.texte: Cerave's tinted sunscreen has been a fantastic addition to my daily skin care routine. It's absorbs easily and fully leaving very little residue. I do notice a little shimmer, but honestly it's hard to see unless you look up close. The consistency is smooth and glides right effortlessly. I have not had any breakouts while using this product and believe it to be usefu and compatible for sensitive skin. It does a decent job hiding the red on my skin and adds a subtle glow. Being a redhead, I have very light skin and I am impressed with what this does for me. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
Works great under make up or no make up alone Love the tint giving a little coverage any time
It's not the worst mineral skin tint. the coverage is average and the color worked for me. But it looked very greasy on my skin.
I was hoping to find an affordable tinted sunscreen that works for black skin. I tried the deep and medium sunscreen and both left a slight white cast on my skin. I wouldn't recommend it.

I really thought i had found a great daily wear sunscreen option until my skin started to become irritated. It's on the moisturizing side. The light shade worked well for my light cool skin tone. Unfortunately by the end of the day my skin was red and irritated. I do have very sensitive skin with rosacea.
this product is so oily and disgusting! would not recommend to my worst enemy. also very orange and does not blend no matter what kind of skin prep you do.

My dermatologist recommended I use two serums and switch to a tinted sunscreen every day to help with melasma. This is a brand I trust at a really nice pricepoint. The medium tone blended beautifully, but immediatly pilled on my face over my serums even though I had let them dry before application. The sunscreen itself was a little too "dewy" looking for me… my face glistened in a way that looked greasy. I am going to keep trying to find a way to keep it from pilling, but be aware that may be an issue for you.
Its a great sunscreen tint to pit on after your moisturizer. If you're an olive skin tone this is for you. It also gives a dewy fresh look.

I've been using this sunscreen for years on and off. The original universal shade (on my hand in the photo compared to new shade) was way too dark so I had to mix it with a white sunscreen which was annoying. Chemical sunscreens burn my eyes and break me out. Other mineral sunscreens have too much whitecast or are too expensive for everyday use. Finally they have a shade light enough that I dont have to mix it with another mineral sunscreen. Hydrating, doesnt burn my eyes, no white cast, great under makeup or alone, affordable.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had 3 shade options. I went with the Medium Sheer Tint. The coverage on my skin was great. Like it's packaged it's lightweight and non-greasy. I've worn this as is a light tint when I'm just running around doing errands. When I've used makeup it's still feels light under. The size bottle is not big, easy to travel with as well. Daily use to protect from the sun.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I got sent three shades. I've been using the medium sheer. I love how hydrating this is. It's really great I use it as a base for my powder when I don't wear any makeup which is basically almost daily. The only thing I don't like about this product is the bottle I hope they upgrade it to pump instead because its really very messy because it's really light weight whatever tiny little bit left after getting the product it's just gets everywhere. But formula wise it's really good.

avis.titre: I love the glow it provides with no smell
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Cerave sheer tint mineral sunscreen is hydrating and the tint is really nice with a little glow. Photos show the Medium and Deep. I thought one would be too dark and the other too light so initially I mixed them. I went in with another layer of both ~ the deep on the left and the medium on the right. As you can see, there is just a slightly deeper bronzing effect. Both will work independently for my complexion. It is definitely light weight. The dish is..... go grab it. What a great addition to the other skincare items offered by CeraVe..

I received tinted sunscreen in exchange for my honest review. I have been a long time user of CeraVe and highly recommend most of their line. The sunscreen is a good affordable option for daily use along with the tinted color. It blends very well into the skin.
this product is very oily and does not mix well with ither products, including elf. it also is difficult to rub or blend into skin, even woth no other products on face.
I got this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I've only used it a couple of times, on no makeup days. I have sensitive skin and didn't have any issues with this product.
Very hydrating and good coverage. Perfect for days when you don't need foundation.

This sunscreen wears well, and I appreciate the different levels of tint, although I fall between the light and medium. The texture and finish are quite elegant for the price point, but the one con would be the packaging. The way it dispenses ends up collecting in the lid and gets messy after a few uses.

avis.titre: Skin protection with a beautiful Glow!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really surprised how much I enjoyed this product, it is hydrating without adding oil, I love the slight shimmer and brightening it gives and packaged just right for in the go.

avis.titre: Works great with my skin type
avis.texte: I have seborrheic psoriasis, and it's always been important to me to protect my skin with SPF. However, too many of them made my skin so oily. This mineral sunscreen has worked the best at keeping my sensitive skin protected and oil-free.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. For a sunscreen product, I actually really liked this. Gives good coverage and blends nicely. Also doesn't smell as much as regular sunscreen products. Nice to have for pool, beach, boat and lake days!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm usually pretty skeptical about tinted sunscreens or tints because they don't really do much, but this one was probably the best I've tried. It does have a little bit of a greasy finish which I always hate, but I found that it sat well under powder which helped to at least get rid of some of the shine. Overall, the tint was enough to tone down some of my redness but didn't sit like a full coverage product which I liked. It does seem like it needs to be reapplied pretty regularly which doesn't really work under makeup.

I've purchased at least 10 of these and use it every day. Covers lightly but makes skin look even- almost like having a filter on but doesnt look like makeup. Moisturizer, sunscreen and coverage-- 3 benefits in 1 with 1 step.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sunscreen has become my absolute go-to on days when I want my skin protected but don't feel like wearing a full face of makeup. The tint is super natural — it evens out my skin tone just enough without feeling heavy or looking like foundation. It gives me that "your skin but better" look. What I love most is how hydrating it is. It feels like a moisturizer and sunscreen in one, so I don't have to layer a bunch of products. Most mineral sunscreens leave a white cast, but this one blends in perfectly thanks to the tint. It gives my skin a soft, healthy glow without looking greasy. On lazy days, I literally just use this, a little concealer, and mascara, and I still feel put together. It's lightweight, comfortable, and my skin stays protected all day — which is the whole point of SPF anyway. Have not had any breakouts or irritation as well!

avis.titre: Tinting isn't for me - but love CeraVe!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] To start with - I really like CeraVe. I think they have great products. This one was not for me - I didn't care for the tint options available and felt as though the product sat on my skin more than I'd like it to. I will stick to untinted.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Love it! Hydrates without feeling greasy and perfect for daily wear. Comes in three different shades. Also, great for sensitive or dry skin. Huge plus that it is broad spectrum protection and it is gentle.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't wear makeup on most days, so on those days I need to wear sunscreen. (My makeup has sunscreen) This is a good product. I used the light version, my daughter used the next color, not the darkest. It was smooth enough. The only reason for not giving out the most stars is because I've tried similar products that I like better.
I honestly love this tinted spf for the price. It's an excellent price for mineral sunscreen and the sunscreen actually works unlike some of the more expensive brands.

[I received this product free in exchange for my honest review]. This is not a bad tinted moisturizer. Since it's a tinted moisturizer, and not a foundation, it is pretty translucent and each shade would accommodate different skin tones well. My big problem with this (why I gave 4 stars instead of 5) is that it feels like it's sitting on my skin all the time. It's not "weightless" for me. Otherwise, it is great at evening out my skin and neutralizing some of my redness!

this is a great option for someone who needs some color to add to there face. i used the whole bottle and plan to buy more. i have recomend this to my mom. she has used it and she likes it just as much as i do.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I overall think this product is great. It has a slight sunscreen smell to it, which I don't mind I actually like the scent. It is not over powering and subsides after a bit. The coverage is very sheer and forgiving. The shade deep is a bit muddy, but that is because it just simply isn't the correct shade. It contains ceramides and niacinamide. Ceramides help protect the skins natural barrier and help the skin stay hydrated. Niacinamide helps reduce inflammation and hyperpigmentation. The finish is glowy. This is not meant for swimming or sweating and must be reapplied every two hours. My favorite part about this product is that it doesn't pill or roll when you blend it in.

avis.titre: I would buy this product for my everyday regiment
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love cerave as they are gentle on my sensations skin i received 3 shades and shared with my daughters as were all different complexions from fair to dark the packaging is small easy to carry on small purse the hydration and sun protection this small product gives goes a long way and honestly i didn't smell any scent its great for everyday wear and for easy regiments if your going to use any skin care product grab you one of these they blend easy and sun protection is something most of us dont practice this is easy to apply and blend into your face

I received this complimentary product in exchange for my honest review and here it is! I used CeraVe moisturizer in the beginning of my illness with topical steroid withdrawal. It became a holy grail for me when it came to healing my skin barrier. However there was a time where I had to stop because my skin was just so raw and sensitive. This moisturizer was the first one I have used on my face in a while. It made my skin feel moisturized and hydrated the whole day. It gives me enough coverage to hide the red spots on my face when I have a flare. And it also gave grace to the lines and dry spots caused by the itch scratch cycle this illness brings. Most tinted moisturizers would set into them and make it more obvious. All in all I'm thankful to have something in my makeup staples to use when I want to recognize myself again! My only suggestion would be adding more undertones, I'm more of an olive and I found the color to be a tad bit beige but as an artist I found myself mixing deep and medium to give me the color I needed. Thank you Cerave!

avis.titre: Mineral protection without the white cast!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed this mineral sunscreen! I tried the shade light. Most importantly, I did not get a sunburn while wearing it at any point. In my opinion, if you are looking for a product to offer sunscreen and meaningful coverage, this is not for you - I found the tint prevented any white cast and had a smoothing effect on my skin, but you could still fully see my coloring coming through underneath. (I have freckles, and they are totally visible, which I was happy for!) I think this is a positive, because it leads me to believe each shade would work for a wider range of skin tones without having to be worried too much about the color match. However, if you have very rosy skin, the undertones of the light shade might be too yellow - I, however, have yellow undertones and was grateful it was not overly cool toned. I have dry-to-normal skin, and the finish is dewy without being greasy. The packaging makes it easy to dispense and a little goes a long way. It seems to be lasting me a long time, making it a good value for the price! Overall, I could definitely see myself repurchasing this product in the future for effortless protection with a little glow.

This has been awesome to try. It's so light you don't know you're wearing it! It gives you a beautiful glow it does go on smooth and gives a beautiful coverage. And it has great SPF in it as well which I love! I also got all three shades

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The sunscreen is smooth, and it spreads easily. It doesn't smell very sunscreeny, and it doesn't smell like anything to me. also, a big plus for me is that it's not greasy at all, and it is basically undetectable.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the feel of this sunscreen. It goes on very smooth and covers easily. It provides good protection. it does not have any smell to it so there's nothing overwhelming about it. I love the new light shade. it blends in nicely with my skin tone. It does, however, have a little bit of a greasy feel.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Matched my skin tone beautifully. Applied it to my hand in the photo. It is a lotion texture. Very smooth, non oily like some sunscreens. There's is no scent which is a plus!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] One of my favorite tinted sunscreens! The coverage is very good and makes no make up days so much easier! This sunscreen does have a little white cast to it but I still enjoy wearing it. I love the smooth, lotion like texture to it. It makes it seem like I'm wearing nothing on my face. I highly recommend trying this tinted sunscreen!
Great everyday sunscreen tint. It wasn't as oily and left my skin protected. It doesn't really have a scent to it. I would have liked if there are more shade options but overall I love it.

After trying this product for a while, I ended up liking it a lot. I like that it feels light weight and not thick. And it feels nice on the skin and not sticky. The packaging is average , but the smell if a little strong. And it had good SPF protection.

avis.titre: A solid mineral sunscreen with the added benefit of tint
avis.texte: The CeraVe Hydrating Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30 Face Sheer Tint is a tinted sunscreen that gives your skin a nice glow in addition to protecting your skin from the sun's UVA and UVB rays. It does not leave a white residue or "white cast" that some sunscreens leave. Only downside is that the residue or tint may wear off on clothing if your face touches your shirt like when you're taking your shirt off, especially shirts that are white.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using the dark shade on my fair to medium skin. It works as the perfect bronzer and protection. I've actually received many compliments on the way my skin looks with this on. There is no strong smell and it comes in a conveniently sized bottle.

avis.titre: Solid option for a tinted mineral sunscreen
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted sunscreen is overall pretty good. I tend to like chemical sunscreens more but for a mineral one it's really nice. You definitely need to pay attention to the color of the product based on your skin tone because like all mineral sunscreens there's a bit of a caste. I'm really pale so it was fine, but if you have a darker skin tone I would definitely patch test. But it applies well and isn't heavy at all. CeraVe is always so gentle so if you have sensitive skin this is definitely worth a try.

Great sunscreen. I only had to reapply once because I was in the sun al day. It went on nice and smooth and streak free. The only downside was that it left some residue on the collar of my son's white shirt. It did come of easily. There was no strong scent. The mineral ingredients were perfect for my son's sensitive skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is more of a full coverage foundation than a sunscreen. It was super greasy and would get worse throughout the day. My skin broke out from using this product for a week. I wanted to love it as it was a great foundation/sunscreen but it was just way too greasy!

avis.titre: Gentle tinted sunscreen but no coverage
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It has SPF 30 and it also brights up my skin without leaving a residue. Not too greasy considering it's a sunscreen but it's definitely on the more oil side. No scent and no coverage.

This has been a complete game changer in wearing sunscreen and makeup! I've been using this consistently for weeks and it's amazing! The picture shows me using it primarily, with a smidge of concealer before heading out into the sun. This has protected my face well, caused zero irritation like other face sunscreens and looks great with my skin tone. I used the light tube I received and it matched well. I would definitely buy again, and already have it on a list!

An affordable, gentle, and effective tinted mineral sunscreen option, ideal for everyday use if you're looking for hydration and lightweight protection without "white cast." It's really perfect for me
I bought this for my husband. He loves it, this is the first time he has used this product. He definitely will recommend to his coworkers.

I was slightly disappointed with this. It's great as a stand alone. But it doesn't work well under makeup. However, in the summer if you don't want a full face of makeup, this would be great. Just a light tint.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoy putting this product on before my makeup. It has a nice tint to it and I enjoy that it has sun protection. The coverage is light but that's okay with me because it give a natural look and finish. I like the packaging.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The 3 shades of the CeraVe Hydrating Mineral Sunscreen are very forgiving so don't worry about a color match. It blends very easily and no discernible scent. My problem? It leaves you VERY shiny and does feel a little greasy. This one is a fail for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sunscreen is amazing. I love it! I used the medium shade. It was perfect for my tanned skin. It gave me a little bit of a tint, which was perfect. It protected my skin pretty well because I haven't gotten burnt since I started using it. It goes on your skin so smooth without feeling yucky or like you put to much on. I got this product for free for reviewing.

I've been using the Cetacean Sheet Tint Minerals Sunscreen daily and I really like it. It goes on like a typical sunscreen definitely a bit oily at first but once it sets, it dries down and doesn't feel greasy at all. The tint adds just the right amount of color to even out my skin tone, which I love. It's become part of my everyday routine because it protects my skin while I'm out and gives me that subtle, natural glow. Highly recommend if you want sun protection with a hint of coverage!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this sunscreen! It feels lightweight, blends smoothly into my skin, and doesn't leave a heavy or greasy feeling like many other mineral sunscreens. The sheer tint is amazing because it evens out my skin tone while still looking natural. I also like that it has options for light, medium, and deep tones, so it's easier to find the right match. Another big plus is that it's formulated with ceramides and niacinamide, which makes my skin feel hydrated and calm throughout the day. I have sensitive skin, and this sunscreen doesn't irritate me at all.

I love the brand cerave in general and they're packaging so that isn't the issue. While these are meant to be sheer the shade range is still an issue. I was sent 3 shades as pictured but even the darkest one I am scared it will leave a white cast. It doesn't have a scent much like the rest of their products but the shades need more range and undertones

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The texture to this sunscreen is pretty oily I noticed my t zone was getting extremely oily when using this. I can also feel the later on my face throughout my day which really frustrated me. It didn't break me out though so that's a plus but it also didn't cover any of my existing breakouts.

CeraVe Hydrating Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30 is my go-to! It applies smoothly, feels hydrating without being greasy, and now comes in multiple shades that give the perfect natural glow. Gentle, protective, and better than many pricier tinted sunscreens I've tried—an everyday must-have.

avis.titre: Lightweight, hydrating, and perfectly tinted, this sunscreen
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen! The sheer tint blends beautifully into my skin, giving me just the right amount of coverage while keeping it protected from the sun. It feels lightweight, non-greasy, and actually hydrates throughout the day without clogging pores. I also appreciate that it's formulated with ceramides and niacinamide, so it's not just sun protection but also skincare. Perfect for everyday wear, especially if you want a natural, healthy glow without heavy makeup.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I always put less makeup on face . Its a great addition to my routine as its a sunscreen with a tint. Doesn't require extra foundation or bb/cc cream to look glam for a quick outing . Shade match perfectly with my skin and blend really well.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] These CeraVe tinted mineral sunscreens are perfect—lightweight, hydrating, and blend seamlessly without feeling greasy. I love that they come in different shades, protect with SPF 30, and are gentle enough for sensitive skin. The formula feels smooth, natural, and nourishing with ceramides and niacinamide, making it a daily essential for healthy glowing skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The moisturizer feels lightweight but I found that all the shades ran pretty ashy and not really suitable for darker or even medium skin tones. The fair shade works okay on me but it does not provide a lot of coverage at all.

I like this lightweight mineral sunscreen for my no makeup days. The light color is very pale, especially for the summer, I will probably use it more in the winter but overall a good product. I don't notice any white cast or oxidation throughout the day.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice product, packaging is simple and clean. It has good coverage, you don't need to apply too much, so sun protection should be effective. The color match is on point if your complexion matches one of the 3 options, but other than that, it's limited.

avis.titre: No white cast, great for darker skin tones
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed these tinted sunscreens. First I wanna say it was nice that they sent various shades. Our family is culturally mixed and one of us used dark, one medium, and one light. It's usually har to find a mineral sunscreen for darker skin tones that doesn't leave a white cast, but I was really impressed with this. No scent which I appreciate, and it blended in nicely. I would definitely recommend this especially for darker skin tones looking for a sunscreen that won't leave a white cast.

avis.titre: Love it - my new go to!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Cerave sheer tint mineral sunscreen is hydrating and the tint is really nice with a little glow. Photos show the Medium and Deep. I thought one would be too dark and the other too light so initially I mixed them. I went in with another layer of both ~ the deep on the left and the medium on the right. As you can see, there is just a slightly deeper bronzing effect. Both will work independently for my complexion. It is definitely light weight and no peeling like some of the other mire expensive brands. The dish is..... go grab it. What a great addition to the other skincare items offered by CeraVe.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this! I've recently been introduced to tinted sunscreen and I like it as a way to protect my skin when I don't want to wear makeup. The Cerave tinted sunscreen is lightweight and goes on smoothly. It doesn't smell like anything. It also blends in to my skin without making me look purple or pasty. It literally disappeared on my skin which was great. I initially was worried because it was so much lighter than my actual skin tone but it blended right in. The only small "complaint" was I expected the tint to give me a teeny bit of coverage and it didn't do that.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] CereVe Hydrating Mineral Sunscreen is wonderful light protection from the sun. It goes on light but nicely moisturizes ,so you don't need moisturizer under your make-up. It's not greasy, nor is it heavy, like others that claim they are lightweight. The coverage is just enough for a casual meeting. I have sensitive skin, so this is perfect for me, and I highly recommend this for others.

I really like this CeraVe Tinted Sunscreen for days when you want something easy with a bit of coverage. The mineral formula feels gentle on my skin, and the sheer tint helps cancel out the usual white cast. I also love that CeraVe recently added new shades, which makes it easier to find a better match. It's very hydrating—enough to take the place of a moisturizer—and it leaves a natural, slightly dewy finish with light coverage. My only concern is that some of the ingredients (like certain emollients) might feel a bit heavy for acne-prone or very oily skin, so it may not be ideal for everyday use. I also appreciate that it's completely fragrance-free. The price is great for the quality, and overall it's affordable, protective, and a great option if you want sun protection with a touch of tint.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The shade I got was too dark for my skin tone lol, but it does still give a nice BB cream look to your skin in lazy days that you don't want to put on make up. I love the double duty skin tint and sunscreen combo though! It is also a bit buildable so if you want more coverage you can put more on.

was surprised at how well this mineral sunscreen blended into my skin. There is no purple or white cast in it that is typical with mineral sunscreens. It has a tint that blends well. It feels good on my skin and not too thick.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried the CeraVe Mineral Tinted Sunscreen SPF 30 in all three shades, and medium was the perfect match. It feels lightweight, blends smoothly, and gives my skin a natural, glowy look. The coverage is light but enough to even out tone, and the minimal scent is nice. The simple tube packaging is easy to use, and I like knowing I'm getting mineral SPF 30 protection for everyday wear.
